scope: Proposition 3.2 of the manuscript “The Margulis–Platonov conjecture over number fields” (preprints/The-Margulis-Platonov-conjecture-over-number-fields-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 018 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 545dc0b02e847a4c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 17. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: With the preceding notation, the following statements hold. (i) Let a, b ∈ A0. For every v ∈ A, suppose that xv, tv ∈ U(kv) commute and have determinants av, bv. There exist commuting x′, t ∈ U(k) with det x′ = a and det t = b whose A-components approximate the prescribed pair arbitrarily closely. (ii) Let γ ∈ V0 and h ∈ U(k). There exist commuting x′, t ∈ U(k) with x′ ∈ γR, det t = det h, and with tA arbitrarily close to hA.
